title: CloudVault: Backup & Storage
summary: Auto backup photos, contacts & files. 15 GB free cloud storage.
description:
CloudVault — Auto Phone Backup, Cloud Storage & Restore

Never lose your photos, contacts, or files again. CloudVault automatically backs up everything on your Android phone — photos, videos, documents, contacts, and audio — to secure cloud storage. Restore it all on any new phone in minutes.

🔒 WHY CLOUDVAULT?
Your phone holds everything — your memories, your contacts, your work. One broken screen or lost device, and it's all gone. CloudVault is the easiest Android cloud backup app built to protect what matters most.

✅ KEY FEATURES

📸 AUTO PHOTO & VIDEO BACKUP
CloudVault automatically backs up your photos and videos over WiFi — no manual uploads needed. Your memories are safe even if your phone is lost, stolen, or damaged. Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC, MP4, and MOV.

👤 CONTACTS BACKUP & RESTORE
Switching to a new phone? With one tap, CloudVault backs up all your contacts and restores them to any Android device instantly. Never re-enter a phone number again. Works with every Android brand.

📄 DOCUMENTS & FILES BACKUP
Back up your PDFs, Word files, Excel sheets, and text documents automatically. CloudVault scans your Downloads folder and selected locations to ensure every important file is safe in the cloud.

🎵 AUDIO & VOICE MEMO BACKUP
Back up your MP3 music library, voice memos, and voice recordings. Choose which audio types to include with per-category toggles.

💬 WHATSAPP MEDIA BACKUP (Pro)
Google Drive filling up with WhatsApp photos and videos? CloudVault Pro backs up your entire WhatsApp media folder separately — so your Google storage stays free. Ideal for users in Pakistan, India, and South Asia.

☁️ FREE CLOUD STORAGE
Get 15 GB of free cloud storage — enough for thousands of photos and hundreds of documents. Need more? Earn extra storage by watching a short video or referring a friend. Upgrade to Pro for 100 GB or Max for 1 TB.

⚙️ SMART BACKUP CONTROLS
• WiFi-only backup — no mobile data charges • Charging-only option — backup while you sleep • Choose backup frequency: daily, weekly, or manual • Select exactly which folders and file types to include • 30-day deleted file recovery (90 days on Pro)

🔄 RESTORE ON ANY NEW PHONE
Changing your phone? Sign in to CloudVault on your new device and restore contacts, photos, and documents in minutes. Our guided new phone setup wizard makes switching phones completely stress-free.

📊 STORAGE DASHBOARD
See exactly how your storage is used — breakdown by photos, videos, documents, and audio. Know when you're running low and manage your files with one tap.

🔐 SECURE & PRIVATE
CloudVault stores your files on AWS servers — the same infrastructure trusted by Netflix, Airbnb, and NASA. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Only you can access your files.

💎 CLOUDVAULT PLANS
Free — 15 GB cloud storage, auto backup, contacts backup, ads Pro — 100 GB, no ads, unlimited restores, file sharing links — $1.99/month or $14.99/year Max — 1 TB, 2-account sharing, 1-year recovery — $6.99/month or $59.99/year All plans include: automatic backup, contacts backup and restore, storage dashboard, and access from any device.

Download CloudVault free today. Set up in 60 seconds. Your backup starts automatically. Stop worrying about losing your photos, contacts, or files — ever again.
